def _prefix(node, end):
    if end == node.n:
        return node.h
    if node.b is None:
        # Sparse checkpoints bound partial literal hashing to 63 bytes. They
        # are shared by every slice of the literal, not by checksum equality.
        checkpoints, h = array('Q', [0]), 0
        for i, c in enumerate(node.a, 1):
            h = (h*257+c+1) & MASK
            if i % 64 == 0:
                checkpoints.append(h)
        node.b = checkpoints
    block, tail = divmod(end, 64)
    h = node.b[block]
    for c in node.a[end-tail:end]:
        h = (h*257+c+1) & MASK
    return h


def _view(node, lo, hi):
    if node.kind == 3:
        lo, hi, node = lo+node.b, hi+node.b, node.a
    p = pow(257, hi-lo, MOD)
    h = (_prefix(node, hi)-_prefix(node, lo)*p) & MASK
    lf = node.a.find(b'\\n', lo, hi)
    return Bytes(3, hi-lo, h, p, 1, lf-lo if lf >= 0 else -1, node, lo)
